title: wg: protocol-06 §5.9 AbuseReport optional/UTF-8 fields
description: Suggestion/erratum. §5.9 calls reportingUser optional but types it bare IdentifierUri (mimid treats empty as absent, mimid-1wgh.5.59); calls note UTF-8 but types it opaque<V> (mimid-1wgh.5.60). Editorial: FrankingIntegrityTBS writes 'opaque server_frank[32]' where Frank writes 'uint8 server_frank[32]' (same encoding). Fix: optional<IdentifierUri>, UTF8String, consistent types.
